description: Heap Classic loader on cdn.heapanalytics.com/js/heap-{appId}.js. Heap.js 5 is vendor/heap. Server-side /api/track is vendor/heap-track.

params.name: app_id
params.description: It is the Heap environment ID. Heap documents the Classic snippet as `cdn.heapanalytics.com/js/heap-{YOUR_APP_ID}.js`.
params.fix_hint: Copy the snippet from Heap Projects so the path is `/js/heap-{appId}.js`.
